CVE-2025-29903: False positive. kotlin-android-extensions-runtime-1.9.22.jar and kotlin-parcelize-runtime-1.9.22.jar are build-time transitive artifacts pulled in by AGP. They are NOT shipped in the APK and do not run on end-user devices. CVE-2025-29903 affects the Kotlin IDE plugin, not Android runtime libraries. OWASP incorrectly matches the "1.9.22" version string to the Kotlin CPE. Project Kotlin version is 2.0.21 (unaffected).

CVE-2023-2976: Guava Files.createTempDir() world-readable temp dir on UNIX. Not applicable to Android: Android sandbox prevents cross-app file access regardless of POSIX permissions, and Firebase/this app do not call createTempDir(). Transitive runtime dependency pulled in by Firebase SDK (firebase-common).
CVE-2020-8908: Guava temp dir vulnerability (CVSS 3.3 — below threshold). Suppressed for report hygiene. Same root cause as CVE-2023-2976; not applicable on Android. Transitive dep of Firebase SDK.

False positive: play-services-measurement-*.aar (firebase-analytics transitive dep). OWASP CPE matching incorrectly associates these Google Play Services measurement AARs with CVEs for unrelated server-side or desktop products. These AARs run inside the Android app sandbox (not on a server) and do not expose network services. Filed under PR #331 Firebase integration.

False positive: firebase-encoders-json / firebase-encoders-proto AARs. These are Firebase-internal serialization helpers (transitive deps of firebase-crashlytics and firebase-datatransport). No known CVEs. Suppressed to prevent OWASP CPE mis-matching against unrelated json/protobuf products.

False positive: firebase-datatransport AAR. Firebase crash-report batching library; no known CVEs. Suppressed to prevent OWASP from matching the "datatransport" or version string against unrelated products.
False positive: firebase-installations AARs. Firebase Installation ID management libraries; no known CVEs. Suppressed to prevent OWASP version/name mis-matching.

False positive / build-time only: google-services Gradle plugin 4.4.2. This plugin and its transitive dependencies (e.g. google-http-client, google-auth-library) run only during the Gradle build. They are NOT shipped in the APK. CVEs in build tools do not affect end users.

CVE-2021-22573: google-auth-library-oauth2-http token-exchange vulnerability. Affects versions before 1.1.0. Present (if at all) only as a build-time transitive dependency of the firebase-crashlytics Gradle plugin used for mapping-file upload. NOT shipped in the APK; not a runtime vulnerability for end users. Mapping-file upload is also disabled in debug builds.

False positive / build-time only: firebase-crashlytics-gradle plugin JARs. These are Gradle plugin build tools (firebase-crashlytics-gradle, firebase-crashlytics-buildtools). They run only during the build and are NOT shipped in the APK. Any CVE match is a build-tool false positive.
